about_pullquote: Every job we take on gets the same care and attention as our own home.
about_para_1: Calucno was established to bring straightforward, high-quality contracting to Liverpool homeowners and businesses who were fed up with unreliable tradespeople and inflated quotes. Based in Liverpool, we've built our reputation job by job, project by project, always putting quality and communication first. Our team is fully insured and brings hands-on experience across a wide range of contracting disciplines.
about_para_2: What sets Calucno apart is simple: we do what we say we'll do. We arrive when agreed, work to the highest standard, and leave sites clean and tidy. That commitment to reliability has earned us a loyal customer base across Liverpool, with a large proportion of our work coming from repeat clients and personal recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Calucno

reviews.text: Calucno did a fantastic job on our kitchen extension. The lads were professional, tidy, and kept us informed throughout. Finished on time and within budget — couldn't ask for more. Would absolutely recommend to anyone in Liverpool looking for a trustworthy contractor.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Used Calucno for a full bathroom and bedroom refurb. From the initial quote to the final handover, everything was seamless. The quality of the work is brilliant and the team were respectful of our home at all times. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Really impressed with the groundworks and patio they completed for us. Turned up when they said they would, which alone puts them ahead of most. The finished result looks superb and has really transformed the back garden. Highly recommend Calucno.
reviews.author: Stephen R.
